results.rationale: Solar Energy deployment projects indicate relevant PV experience but do not explicitly evidence full EPC (design/supply/install/test/commission), DISCO net-metering approvals, and 3-year O&M scope as required.
Hospital IT deployments are adjacent to the hospital context but do not clearly demonstrate physical site surveys and detailed engineering design for solar/PV works at each hospital.
No provided evidence confirms supply of Tier-1 PV modules, string inverters, and mounting structures (brand/bankability tier and equipment specifications are not shown).

Solar Energy deployment suggests potential installation capability, but evidence does not explicitly state execution of civil and electrical installation works for PV systems (bridge/road projects are not directly applicable).
No evidence demonstrates SCADA-based remote monitoring for solar PV with a central dashboard; the listed cybersecurity/mobile banking projects are not SCADA/solar monitoring implementations.
Solar deployment project titles do not explicitly evidence liaison with DISCOs or obtaining net-metering licenses/approvals.
Hospital IT deployments plausibly include user training, but the evidence does not specifically confirm training of hospital engineering staff for solar PV systems.
No evidence explicitly confirms comprehensive solar PV O&M with performance guarantees for three years; listed bridge/road projects do not establish PV O&M capability or term/guarantee commitments.
